statement: LLM-based root cause localization for microservices has few Q1 studies
matrix_evidence: concept-combos.csv: microservice & llm_generative = 7 primary papers (P07 P09 P18 P30 P31 P42 P45); microservice & llm_generative & multi_system_2plus = 5
closest_papers_and_locators: P07 Sec IV.A; P09 Sec 5.1; P18 Experimental Setup; P30 Sec 5.2 Table 4; P31 Datasets/Table 1; P42 Sec 4.1-4.2; P45 Sec 9.1 Table 1
difference_from_closest: Gap as stated in the 05/10 report no longer holds. Residual niche: open-weight LLM (<=8B) on several RCAEval systems: llm_generative & open_weight_llm & rcaeval = 0; open_weight & multi_system_2plus = 1 (P31, 70B-class backbones, Nezha only)
falsification_queries: falsification-log.csv rows G1: OpenAlex journals 2020-2026 (2026-10-12) n=56, 12 Q1 in top 50; arXiv 2024-2026 n=18

statement: No Q1 study measures how the retrieval design (sparse vs dense vs hybrid, with/without rerank, retrieval on/off) changes root-cause localization accuracy (AC@k) for microservice incidents
matrix_evidence: concept-combos.csv: microservice & llm_generative & retrieval_variants_compared = 0; llm_generative & retrieval_variants_compared & multi_system_2plus = 0; & rcaeval = 0
closest_papers_and_locators: P49 Abstract, Discussion Table 9 (retrieval quality only, Loghub logs, no LLM output); P50 Sec 3.1-3.5, 5.1-5.2 (RAG did not beat non-RAG on 195 text failure cases, no hybrid); P31 ablation + Conclusions (static top-5 cosine vs keyword; adaptive retrieval named future work); P44 Sec 4.4 (sparse/dense/hybrid ablation on HotpotQA, not RCA)
difference_from_closest: Closest papers either measure retrieval quality without downstream localization (P49), use non-microservice text narratives (P50), or fix one retriever (P31). Out-of-Q1: arXiv 2609.14762 TriCalRAG compares zero/few-shot/RAG for log anomaly detection on BGL/HDFS, not service localization; arXiv 2609.36686 decomposes retrieval/reranking for sensor data without LLM
falsification_queries: falsification-log.csv rows G2: OpenAlex journals 2020-2026 (2026-10-12) n=25, 5 Q1 in top 50 (none microservice + retrieval ablation); arXiv 2024-2026 n=13; plus N2 rows (OpenAlex n=8, 0 Q1; arXiv n=3)
why_it_matters_or_why_empty: Proposal 5.4 and 6.4 already plan hybrid retrieval; P50 gives counter-evidence that RAG can hurt, so the ablation is publishable either way

statement: LLM-RCA for microservices rarely reports calibrated confidence (ECE, coverage, abstention)
matrix_evidence: concept-combos.csv: microservice & llm_generative & calibrated_confidence = 1 (P42); llm_generative & calibrated_confidence = 2 (P42 P67, P67 is log analysis with SLM uncertainty)
closest_papers_and_locators: P42 Sec 3.3 Eq 8-12, Sec 5.1 (ECE, prediction set coverage; GPT-4 API; Train Ticket main data); P30 Sec 6 (HITL because reasoning lacks calibrated uncertainty); P67 Sec 3.3 and Sec 6 (LLM-side uncertainty future work); P50 Sec 6 (confidence-gated RAG proposed, not tested)
difference_from_closest: P42 calibrates a neurosymbolic fusion with a hosted GPT-4 on essentially one system; no Q1 work calibrates an open-weight LLM diagnoser across several systems or uses confidence to decide retrieval/escalation. Out-of-Q1: arXiv 2606.19407 JustDiag (calibrated non-closure on 66 incidents)
falsification_queries: falsification-log.csv rows G3: OpenAlex journals 2020-2026 (2026-10-12) n=23, 11 Q1 in top 50 (mostly off-topic; on-topic: ChatRCA, P42); arXiv 2024-2026 n=35
why_it_matters_or_why_empty: Answers the supervisor question 'why this diagnosis, why this number' (note 29/09) with a measurable quantity

statement: Cost-accuracy trade-off of telemetry compression / token budget for LLM-RCA is not studied as an explicit variable
matrix_evidence: concept-combos.csv: microservice & llm_generative & cost_reported = 6 (P07 P09 P18 P31 P42 P45) but none varies the compression budget
closest_papers_and_locators: P18 Abstract/Setup (bounded context per agent); P45 Sec 9.4 (9.2 calls, 13.8k tokens per incident); P09 Conclusion (latency minutes to seconds); P67 RQ5 (LLM call ratio)
difference_from_closest: Costs are reported as single operating points; no curve of AC@k versus token budget or compression ratio. Out-of-Q1: arXiv 2609.19825 EviRCA (deterministic evidence cards), 2601.04709 (time series to tokens)
falsification_queries: falsification-log.csv rows G4: OpenAlex journals 2020-2026 (2026-10-12) n=10, 2 Q1 in top 50; arXiv 2024-2026 n=79
why_it_matters_or_why_empty: Matches Proposal 5.3 (compression) and the requirement to run on student hardware

statement: No protocol for transferring LLM-RCA trained/tuned on one microservice system to another
matrix_evidence: concept-combos.csv: llm_generative & multi_system_2plus = 5 but all evaluate each system separately

falsification_queries: falsification-log.csv rows G6: OpenAlex journals 2020-2026 (2026-10-12) n=6, 1 Q1 in top 50 (UDA-RCL); arXiv 2024-2026 n=3
why_it_matters_or_why_empty: The key closest paper (P23) was not read in full text, so this gap cannot be confirmed

statement: LLM-RCA under missing modalities or uninstrumented services

closest_papers_and_locators: P18 Threats (blind-spot services break trace-centric search); P08 Sec 8 (missing modalities reduce accuracy); P63 Sec 3.2.1, 4.1.2 (imputation, non-LLM, anomaly detection not RCA); P05 Sec 5.5 (robustness to missing data)

falsification_queries: falsification-log.csv rows N1: OpenAlex journals 2020-2026 (2026-10-12) n=6, 0 Q1 in top 50; arXiv 2024-2026 n=6
